content.title: IEC signs MoU with AEP to pursue energy opportunities in Brazil
content.summary: The agreement enables both parties to jointly identify, assess and pursue acquisitions or participation in oil and gas assets in Brazil.

thumbnail.caption: The move aims to leverage IEC's industry expertise and AEP's local market insights to build a diversified energy portfolio. Credit: Dong Nhat Huy/Shutterstock.com.
